suite: v2.3 source regressions and mocked API boundaries

results.name: Navigation uses all configured root collections
A child is nested once instead of duplicated as a top-level collection
A temporarily missing parent does not make a collection unreachable
Menu ordering follows category sortOrder
Duplicate category IDs do not produce duplicate menu rows
Large bag badges are capped without modifying the underlying quantity
Invalid and negative badge values do not show NaN or negative counts
Blank searches cannot navigate to a misleading empty search
Search encodes special characters and trims surrounding whitespace
Search limits match the existing 150-character catalog contract
The fifth CMS banner is reachable rather than forced into a three-slide loop
The carousel wraps correctly in both directions
Fallback hero count comes from the fallback content
One slide does not divide by zero or produce an invalid position
Page numbers are whole numbers before reaching the backend
Invalid, negative and excessive page values are bounded
Admin-selected primary photo is first, with other gallery images stable
A catalog with no primary flag preserves original gallery order
Empty image lists still normalize without an invented photograph
Waistcoat length is not confused with waist circumference
Trouser waist is not confused with trouser length
Trouser length and inner-leg length receive their different instructions
Snake-case and camel-case sleeve names find the same guidance
A recognized field key wins over a contradictory display label
An unknown measurement does not receive an invented instruction
Valid delivery contact fields are accepted
A punctuation-only phone cannot pass as a delivery number
A misplaced plus sign is rejected in a phone
A country code with spaces or hyphens remains valid
Whitespace-only recipient names are rejected
Invalid postal codes cannot reach order creation
Checkout email validates the whole address instead of only finding @
Closing one of two dialogs leaves document scrolling locked
Double cleanup of the same dialog does not release another dialog lock
Dialog locks are isolated between documents
Fabric 404 responses become a real missing-resource result
Fabric service errors are not disguised as missing products
Published CMS content is retained
Draft CMS content is never displayed even if returned by an endpoint
CMS 404 is a missing page, not an unhandled error
New-arrival API requests retain the supported isNew filter
Preview new arrivals are a subset, not the full collection under another heading
Product API responses honor their primary image flag
A read timeout does not incorrectly claim an order might have been placed
An order timeout preserves the warning about uncertain order submission
Custom checkout is blocked when the category measurement definition is missing
